stages.headline: Two lines (intersecting or skew) are perpendicular if they make 90°; in the cube AA₁ ⊥ AB (intersecting) and AA₁ ⊥ DC (skew).
stages.headlineEnglish: Two lines (intersecting or skew) are perpendicular if they make 90°; in the cube AA₁ ⊥ AB (intersecting) and AA₁ ⊥ DC (skew).

stages.headline: Lemma: if one of two parallel lines is perpendicular to a third line, so is the other.
stages.headlineEnglish: Lemma: if one of two parallel lines is perpendicular to a third line, so is the other.

stages.headline: Example: CC₁ ∥ BB₁ and BB₁ ⊥ AB, so CC₁ ⊥ AB even though they are skew.
stages.headlineEnglish: Example: CC₁ ∥ BB₁ and BB₁ ⊥ AB, so CC₁ ⊥ AB even though they are skew.
